pages.text: [#](53341a)Not everything useful comes from a kettle. Some ingredients must be rendered down first — reduced, transformed, made into something the craft can use.[#]()
pages.title: The Witches' Oven

pages.text: [#](53341a)The Witches' Oven smolders logs into witches' ash, coaxes nether wart into **Exhale of the Horned One**, and works quartz into quicklime.[#]()
[#](53341a)Place a clay jar to catch the rising fumes.[#]()
[#](53341a)Iron and netherbrick, shaped with intent. The oven needs only a fire beneath and materials worth its attention.[#]()
